g.title: Validated LoginEvent — entered via POST /api/v1/ato/decisions (ato_reasoner/api.py) or the in-process eval driver (ato_reasoner/eval/driver.py).
FeatureService.compute() — sliding-window velocity + novelty + impossible-travel features over Redis state. ato_reasoner/feature_service.py.
Per-account ato:* hashes, sets, and sorted sets for sliding windows. TTL-managed. Owned by the ATO reasoner (reasoners/account_takeover/compose.yaml; ATO_REDIS_URL), not the framework.
AtoScorer.score() — XGBoost over AtoFeatureVector → ScorerOutput (risk_score, top SHAP signals, GateRoute). ato_reasoner/scorer/.

build_observation() — the only function crossing the domain → framework boundary. Translates (LoginEvent, AtoFeatureVector, ScorerOutput) into an Observation with ReasonerContext + GateContext + (fast_path_rationale on fast path). ato_reasoner/assembler.py.

execute_decision first runs validate_observation against the reasoner registry (registered reasoner, allowed gate / template / jurisdictions), then inspects observation.route. ATO thresholds: FAST_PATH_ALLOW < 0.20; FAST_PATH_BLOCK > 0.95; otherwise ROUTE_TO_GATE. app/decide.py.

PolicyRetriever.retrieve() — pgvector HNSW (dense) + Elasticsearch BM25 (sparse) → RRF fusion → cross-encoder rerank (latency-budget bypass falls back to RRF-only). Filters: reasoner_id (tenant) and jurisdictions on both stores; risk_tier on pgvector only. app/retrieval/.

PolicyGate.evaluate() — resolves the reasoner's YAML prompt template (from its plugin prompts_dir) via gate_config template_id, sends the template's system text, renders with template_vars + retrieved snippets, calls the LLM with a structured-output schema, returns PolicyGateOutput (verdict + rationale + citations) or None on validation failure. app/gate/policy/.
Bypasses retrieval + LLM. fast_path_rationale records why. GateContext is still preserved on the bundle for retrospective shadow evaluation.

resolve(obs, verdict, snippets, decision_id, registration) — pure deterministic rule application. Schema-failure / novel-entity (registration.novel_entity_feature) / low-confidence / jurisdiction-conflict (registration.jurisdiction_conflict_groups) → HOLD; adversarial probe → BLOCK. Severity ladder ALLOW < CHALLENGE < HOLD < BLOCK. Re-runnable byte-identically for replay. app/enforcement/.

build_bundle() composes the immutable DecisionBundle (raw_event Observation, retrieval results, gate_input/gate_output, enforcement decision, latency breakdown). BundleStore.write() persists JSONB to Postgres. app/audit/.
Dense policy embeddings (384-dim, cosine, HNSW).
Sparse policy index with jurisdiction + version filters.
OpenAI / Anthropic — structured-output policy-gate calls.
Append-only audit store in the shared decisionledger schema: decision_bundles JSONB (reasoner_id tenant column) + replay_logs.
